name: Security Scan
author: brightwalker25
description: The weekly security report in the bar: scan health, known vulnerabilities, file integrity, rootkits, leaked secrets and privacy, graded red, amber or green

barWidget.description: A lock in the bar tinted green, amber or red to match the weekly security report, and every section with what is being done about each finding in the panel

schema.label: Re-read the report every (ms)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads the report. This only reads stored scan results, so it is cheap. The scans themselves run on their own schedule.

schema.label: Hide the icon when green
schema.description: Only show the lock when something is amber or red, or when the report cannot be read.
